QUA.notes: Left-end paired entrance; rightmost edge partly clipped in source PDF.

QUE.notes: Right-end paired entrance; single left/bottom entrance. Common end differs from Chilcotin.

SQU.notes: Right-end paired entrance; single left/bottom entrance.
